FOREST.title: Uniform forest negative correlation
FOREST.target: For every finite simple graph G, under the uniform law on all acyclic edge subsets F, prove Pr(e,f in F)<=Pr(e in F)Pr(f in F) for every distinct pair e,f. The measure is unrooted, includes every forest size and disconnected forests, and has unit edge weights.

BT4.title: Four disjoint directed cycles
BT4.target: Prove the k=4 Bermond-Thomassen conjecture: every finite loopless digraph with at most one arc per ordered vertex pair and minimum outdegree at least seven contains four vertex-disjoint genuinely directed cycles. Digons are allowed; all graph orders are included.

MOC4.title: Normal-matrix determinant hull
MOC4.target: For every complex normal 4-by-4 pair A,B with spectra a_i,b_i, prove det(A+B) lies in conv{product_i(a_i+b_sigma(i)):sigma in S_4}. Include singular and repeated-spectrum cases. This is n=4, not the unrestricted Marcus-de Oliveira conjecture.

POS3.title: Width-three balanced pairs
POS3.target: For every finite nonchain poset of width at most three, find incomparable x,y with 1/3<=Pr(x precedes y)<=2/3 under the UNIFORM law on all linear extensions. All finite sizes are included. This is the width-three scope, not unrestricted 1/3-2/3.
